findings.claim: The change rewrites isolated widget tests despite the project's explicit prohibition on writing component tests or expanding legacy unit suites.
findings.evidence: The diff constructs an A2uiSurfaceStore, loads a fixture directly, and mounts SafeA2uiSurface in a standalone MaterialApp for testWidgets('renders the official safe catalog and forwards user intent'); it similarly rewrites the hostile-fixture widget test. Constraint A-9 says 'do not write or run unit, component, isolated ... tests' and 'Existing unit suites are legacy artifacts: do not expand them'; C-2 also prohibits creating isolated component tests. These tests bypass the Riverpod controller and assembled graph path, unlike the updated integration_test/mobile_smoke_test.dart.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the rewritten isolated widget tests and keep the renderer, action-policy, graph-mutation, and refusal assertions in the assembled simulator integration test.
